subject.title: Add maxThreads config for local embedding (node-llama-cpp)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `memorySearch.local.maxThreads` as a supported local llama.cpp embedding config option?
rationale: The source path and upstream dependency contract make the implementation straightforward, but repository policy sets a high bar for new public config surfaces and this is advanced resource tuning rather than a broken documented behavior contract.

options.title: Approve narrow maxThreads knob
options.body: Add an optional advanced field, leave it unset by default, and forward it only to `getLlama` for the official local provider.

options.title: Decline the config expansion
options.body: Keep node-llama-cpp thread selection implicit and direct users needing thread control to external embedding providers or custom plugin ownership.

options.title: Defer for broader local tuning design
options.body: Hold this until maintainers decide whether CPU, GPU, NUMA, and related llama.cpp runtime controls should be exposed together.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow maxThreads knob
recommendation.body: Add an optional advanced field, leave it unset by default, and forward it only to `getLlama` for the official local provider.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent provider-plugin and memory-host refactors make this the clearest available owner for the config/provider boundary decision.
